Text

Source: R/text.R
TextClass.Rd

Text rendered from system fonts as vectorized glyphs. Each glyph is a submobject, so text[1] is the first visible character and Write() or AddTextLetterByLetter() animate letter by letter.

Usage

Text(
  text,
  fill_opacity = 1,
  stroke_width = 0,
  color = "#FFFFFF",
  font_size = DEFAULT_FONT_SIZE,
  line_spacing = -1,
  font = "",
  slant = "NORMAL",
  weight = "NORMAL",
  t2c = NULL,
  t2f = NULL,
  t2g = NULL,
  t2s = NULL,
  t2w = NULL,
  gradient = NULL,
  tab_width = 4,
  warn_missing_font = TRUE,
  height = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  should_center = TRUE,
  disable_ligatures = FALSE,
  use_svg_cache = FALSE,
  markup = FALSE,
  justify = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

text

The string. Newlines start new lines.

fill_opacity, stroke_width

Style; text is filled by default.

color

Color.

font_size

Font size; 48 matches Manim's default.

line_spacing

Line height multiplier.

font

Font family, for example "serif", "mono" or an installed font name.

slant

"NORMAL", "ITALIC" or "OBLIQUE".

weight

"NORMAL", "BOLD" and so on.

t2c, t2f, t2s, t2w, t2g

Named lists mapping substrings (or slices like "[1:4]", 0 based as in Manim) to colors, fonts, slants, weights, or gradients.

gradient

Colors for a gradient across the glyphs.

tab_width

Spaces per tab.

warn_missing_font

Warn when font is not installed (or registered with register_font()), as upstream does.

height, width

Optional target size.

should_center

Center the text at the origin.

disable_ligatures

Keep one submobject per character, with an invisible point for each space, as upstream (default FALSE).

use_svg_cache

Accepted for upstream's signature; glyphs are read from the fonts directly, so there is no SVG to cache.

markup

Parse text as Pango style markup, as MarkupText() does.

justify

For MarkupText(): stretch the lines that wrap (markup lines wrap at 2400 / font_size em, upstream's Pango layout width) to that full width.

...

Passed to VMobject().

Value

A mobject: an R6 object of the class named by the function called. The objects whose names end in Class are the R6 class generators that these functions call.

Examples

Text("Hello manimR", color = BLUE)
#> <Text> 0 points, 11 submobjects
